Negative = discharging.
spec.title: Avg Current — Selected Range (BMV)

spec.description: Sum of the latest PV power of all MPPTs.
spec.title: Total Panel Input (MPPT)

spec.query:
panels = from(bucket: "CAN-data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "fields_pv_power_w")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["msg_type"] == "MPPT")
  |> group(columns: ["device_id"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: now(), _value: r._value }))

draw = from(bucket: "BMV-data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r.msg_type == "BMV" and r._field == "fields_power_w")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: now(), _value: -1.0 * (if r._value < 0.0 then -r._value else r._value) }))

union(tables: [panels, draw])
  |> group()
  |> sum()

spec.description: Total panel input minus absolute BMV power draw. Positive = charging surplus.
spec.title: Net Power (MPPT + BMV)

spec.title: Peak Discharge — Selected Range (BMV)
